body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Reduce the target's next incoming Damage by 2 until the start of your next turn; during that time, it may suppress one ordinary Burning Condition.

surges.html: The target resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
An adjacent willing creature also reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Elemental
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Elemental Full Manifestation (FM-2E). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
